items.titre: Modern Mining targets 40,000 gold ounces from e-waste
items.resume: The resource-recovery company is turning its tested method into a US production hub following a $40-million IPO.

items.titre: Gold price fall nears $3,500 as miners face soaring costs
items.resume: Miners spent a record $441 per oz. on capital to sustain output in the second quarter, up 34% from the first.

items.titre: Tudor dumps copper miners, doubles down on gold, silver
items.resume: He is the second billionaire this week, after Druckenmiller, to offload copper assets as metals face fresh volatility.

items.titre: Central banks rethink gold as global risks mount
items.resume: A new OMFIF report examines shifting reserve strategies, digital gold technology and retail investors' influence on prices.

items.titre: Gold price drops to 14-month low as dollar, yields rise on hawkish Fed rhetoric
items.resume: Spot gold dropped 3%, hitting its lowest level since September 26, 2025.

items.titre: Collective hits gold in rock classed as waste at Apollo
items.resume: Collective discovered gold and silver in waste rock at its Apollo deposit in Colombia, planning to invest $100M next year.

items.titre: Phoenix hits broad gold and copper at old BC mine
items.resume: The company hit broad intervals of copper and gold at Lexington in southern British Columbia.

items.titre: AI strikes copper-gold where explorers gave up in 1969
items.resume: California-based Earth AI’s drilling outlines a 3-km mineralized system in New South Wales as the explorer advances toward its first resource estimate.

items.titre: Guinea clears PDI Gold permit, raising hopes of easing mining backlog
items.resume: Exploration and mining permits have been stalled for more than two years, forcing some companies to revise mine plans.

items.titre: Druckenmiller exits copper, steel and chip stocks to buy gold miners
items.resume: Latest filing reveals a shift away from industrial metals and semiconductors as the billionaire refocuses his portfolio on gold.

items.titre: Goldman forecasts gold price to take two years to recapture all-time highs
items.resume: It took gold just one month to climb more than 30% to a record.

items.titre: Central bank buying to support gold’s climb to $4,650/oz by end-2027, Goldman Says
items.resume: The investment bank said that structural central bank buying will keep a firm bid under gold in 2027.

items.titre: Gold price drops to more than one-year low as US dollar marches higher
items.resume: Spot gold touched its lowest level since October 2025 at $3,830 earlier in the day, as a firm US dollar continued to pressure bullion.

items.titre: In a policy switch, the Fed says its October 2027 meeting will not see a vote on interest rates
items.resume: There will be seven voting meetings next year, with the October session set up as extra time for policy deliberation without a formal vote or post-meeting statement.
